The '''Office of the Emperor''' consisted of the immediate staff of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who directly subordinate to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].  

==History==
Access to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was restricted to only those cleared by the Office of the Emperor in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

According to [[IMQ-54544-XX-07 Security Clearance Black DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], receiving the current firing codes from the Office of the Emperor is one of the strict requirements to be met before activating the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] weapon.
